**Job Requisition ID #

**26WD99977

**Business Consultant - AECO Technical Advisory

****Position Overview

**Autodesk Consulting is looking for a Business Consultant to join our Northern Europe team. This remote role supports strategic customers across the region.

This is a senior individual contributor role combining business consulting, AECO industry expertise and executive advisory. You’ll work with some of Autodesk’s largest customers to shape transformation strategies, define target operating models, and develop business cases and roadmaps that deliver measurable business outcomes.

You’ll advise senior leaders, structure complex business challenges and lead strategic advisory engagements from discovery through executive decision-making. While you won’t configure or implement solutions, you’ll understand how Autodesk and complementary technologies fit within customers’ broader business and technology ecosystems, partnering with technical specialists to turn strategy into actionable delivery plans.

**Main Responsibilities

**

• Build trusted relationships with customer executives, business leaders and transformation teams, acting as a strategic advisor throughout the engagement

• Understand customer objectives, challenges and operating context to define outcome-driven transformation strategies

• Assess operating models, business processes, organizational capabilities, data and digital workflows to identify opportunities for improvement

• Define target-state operating models, transformation roadmaps, business cases, success measures and benefits realization plans

• Lead executive workshops, facilitate decision-making and align stakeholders across complex organizations

• Advise customers on how Autodesk and complementary AECO technologies support business outcomes through effective workflows, data management and interoperability

• Identify and prioritize opportunities for data, automation and AI based on business value, organizational readiness, governance and adoption

• Partner with Solution Architects, technical consultants and customer-facing teams to shape advisory engagements, validate strategic recommendations and develop credible delivery roadmaps

**Minimum Qualifications

**

• Substantial experience in AECO, management consulting or business transformation, with a proven track record of independently leading complex strategy and transformation engagements

• Deep expertise in at least one of the following: construction, infrastructure, engineering consultancy, utilities, or a closely related project-based, asset-intensive industry

• Strong working knowledge of Autodesk technologies or comparable AECO tool ecosystems, with the ability to discuss capabilities, workflow fit, data, interoperability and business value. Hands-on implementation expertise is not required

• Strong understanding of operating models, organizational change, governance, business cases and benefits realization

• Practical understanding of data-centric workflows, enterprise systems, automation, responsible AI and technology adoption

• Ability to lead through influence across cross-functional and international teams, with excellent communication and executive presentation skills

• Fluent English is required. Dutch and other European languages are highly valued

• Willingness to travel to customer meetings and Autodesk events across Northern Europe (up to 50%)

• Proven experience advising executives, structuring complex problems, facilitating high-stakes workshops and driving decisions

****Learn More

******About Autodesk

**Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.

We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.

When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!

**Salary transparency

**Salary is one part of Autodesk’s competitive compensation package. For Netherlands based roles, we expect a starting base salary between 69,000 EUR and 101,200 EUR. Offers are based on the candidate’s experience and geographic location, and may exceed this range. In addition to base salaries, our compensation package may include annual cash bonuses, commissions for sales roles, stock grants, and a comprehensive benefits package.

**Working in sales at Autodesk allows you to build meaningful relationships with customers while growing your career. Join us and help make a better, more sustainable world. Learn more here: https://www.autodesk.com/careers/sales

**We take pride in cultivating a culture of belonging where everyone can thrive. Learn more here: **https://www.autodesk.com/company/global-belonging

jobs.description:
Do you build the kind of customer relationships where trust makes the difference?

At MarineTech, we are looking for a Customer Relations & Order Manager who will take responsibility for a small portfolio of key customers and ensure an excellent customer experience from agreement to delivery.

This is not a traditional sales role focused on hunting for new business. Your success will come from knowing your customers, understanding their needs and business, and building strong, long-term relationships based on trust, reliability and professional advice.

Your role

You will be the customer’s primary point of contact and trusted advisor, working closely with colleagues, suppliers and partners to make sure everything comes together.

You will combine customer relationship management with hands-on responsibility for orders, forecasts and deliveries. This means staying close to your customers, anticipating their needs and ensuring that commitments are followed through.

Your key responsibilities will be to:

• Build, maintain and develop strong relationships with existing customers

• Act as the customer’s primary contact and advise on products, solutions and delivery options

• Manage orders from A to Z, including requirements, prices, terms, documentation and delivery

• Follow up on customer forecasts and coordinate internally to support material and delivery planning

• Coordinate closely with customers, suppliers and internal teams

• Proactively keep customers informed about quotations, orders, deliveries and deviations

• Maintain accurate customer, order and activity data in ERP and CRM

• Identify opportunities to further develop existing customer accounts

• Look forward to 10–15 travel days per year as an opportunity to meet customers, build stronger relationships and get closer to their business.

You probably have experience from B2B customer management, order coordination, sales or customer service. More importantly, you enjoy building relationships and creating a customer experience where people know they can rely on you.

We imagine that you:

• Have experience working with B2B customers and coordinating orders or deliveries

• Have a good commercial understanding and an interest in technical products and solutions

• Are comfortable working with ERP and CRM systems and structured follow-up

• Ideally have experience coordinating with suppliers, carriers and complex deliveries

• Communicate professionally in both Danish and English

As a person

You are outgoing and approachable and naturally create good relationships with customers and colleagues. You are service-minded without losing sight of the commercial perspective.

At the same time, you are structured and proactive. You take ownership, keep an overview when several things are happening at once, and make sure agreements and commitments are followed through to completion.

Why this role?

You will get a role where relationships matter. Rather than constantly chasing the next customer, you will have the opportunity to understand a smaller number of important customers in depth and become a trusted partner in their day-to-day business.

You will be close to both customers and the internal organization, giving you a central role in turning customer needs into reliable solutions and deliveries.

Interested?

If you want to help develop the specialized container and maritime transport industry – while developing yourself professionally and personally – then we look forward to hearing from you.

Send your application and CV as soon as possible. Interviews are held continuously and we will hire once we find the right candidate.

If you have questions, feel free to contact HR Manager Louise Buur at +45 21 20 44 67.

**About Hans Følsgaard (**Hans Følsgaard A/S)

Hans Følsgaard A/S is a global technology company with roots in engineering and a clear ambition to support the green transition through intelligent, reliable solutions. Since 1922, we have provided specialised technology expertise to industry, and our team of more than 120 employees is based across locations in Denmark, Norway, Germany, India and China.

Collaboration, accountability and integrity are at the heart of how we work. We operate with flat organisational structures, take a long-term perspective and value curiosity, professional expertise and initiative.

Department of Mathematical Sciences, Faculty of SCIENCE, University of Copenhagen

   

  Department of Mathematical Sciences (MATH) invites applicants for PhD stipends in mathematics.

  The start date is ordinarily September 1, 2027, but can be subject to negotiation.

  There will be PhD stipends available in:

   	
• Algebraic and Arithmetic Geometry, Applied algebra, Combinatorics, Geometric group theory, Geometry and Geometric Analysis, Number Theory, Representation Theory, and Topology as covered by the section Algebra & Geometry and  Copenhagen Center for Geometry & Topology (GeoTop).    	
• Classical Analysis, Descriptive Set Theory, Functional Analysis, Geometric group theory, Harmonic Analysis, History of Mathematics, Mathematical Physics, Operator Algebras, Partial Differential Equations, Quantum Information, Quantum Computation and Quantum Simulation as covered by the section Analysis and Quantum, the Centre for the Mathematics of Quantum Theory  and the Quantum for Life Center.   You are welcome to contact any member of the department to discuss research projects.

   

  Who are we looking for?

  We are looking for candidates within the field of Mathematics or nearby fields, whose background and research interests are a strong fit with the areas of mathematics above.

  About the department

  The department has about 50 permanent scientific staff members; around 60 PhD students and 35 postdocs. It has strong research groups in many areas of mathematics, and active PhD, postdoc, and visitors’ programs. Our buildings are located in central Copenhagen next to the central park Fælledparken. Our website http://www.math.ku.dk/english provides more information about the department and the research  conducted at the department https://www.math.ku.dk/english/research/.  We offer creative and stimulating working conditions in a dynamic and international research environment.

  You can find more information about the PhD program on the homepage http://www.math.ku.dk/english/programmes/ph.d/. 

   

  The PhD programme 

  Depending on your level of education, you can undertake the PhD programme as either:

  Option A: A three year full-time study within the framework of the regular PhD programme (5+3 scheme), if you already have an education equivalent to a relevant Danish master’s degree.

  Option B: An up to five year full-time study programme within the framework of the integrated MSc and PhD programme (the 3+5 scheme), if you do not have an education equivalent to a relevant Danish master’s degree – but you have an education equivalent to a Danish bachelor’s degree.

  ********************************************************************************

  Option A: Getting into a position on the regular PhD programme 

  Qualifications needed for the regular programme
 To be eligible for the regular PhD programme, you must have completed a degree programme, equivalent to a Danish master’s degree (180 ECTS/3 FTE BSc + 120 ECTS/2 FTE MSc) related to the subject area of the project, e.g. mathematics or closely related. For information of eligibility of completed programmes, see General assessments for specific countries and Assessment database.

  Terms of employment in the regular programme 
 Employment as PhD fellow is full time and for maximum 3 years.

  Employment is conditional upon your successful enrolment as a PhD student at the PhD School at the Faculty of Science, University of Copenhagen. This requires submission and acceptance of an application for the specific project formulated by the applicant.

  Terms of appointment and payment according to the agreement between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State. The position is covered by the Protocol on Job Structure.

  Option B: Getting into a position on the integrated MSc and PhD programme

  Qualifications needed for the integrated MSc and PhD programme 

  If you do not have an education equivalent to a relevant Danish master’s degree, you might be qualified for the integrated MSc and PhD programme, if you have an education equivalent to a relevant Danish bachelor’s degree. Here you can find out, if that is relevant for you: General assessments for specific countries and Assessment database.  

  Terms of the integrated programme
 To be eligible for the integrated scholarship, you are (or are eligible to be) enrolled in one of the faculty’s master’s programmes in Mathematics or Quantum Information Science.

  Students on the integrated programme will enroll as PhD students simultaneously with completing their enrollment in this MSc degree programme.

  The duration of the integrated programme is up to five years, and depends on the amount of credits that you have passed on your MSc programme. For further information about the study programme, please see: www.science.ku.dk/phd, “Study Structures”.

  Until the MSc degree is obtained, (when exactly two years of the full 3+5 programme remains), the grant will be paid partly in the form of up to 48 state education grant portions (in Danish: “SU-klip”) plus salary for work (teaching, supervision etc.) totalling a workload of 150 working hours per year. A PhD grant portion is currently (2026) DKK 7.426 before tax.
 
 When you have obtained the MSc degree, you will transfer to the salary-earning part of the scholarship for a period of two years. At that point, the terms of employment and payment will be according to the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State (AC). The position is covered by the Protocol on Job Structure.

   

  Responsibilities and tasks in both PhD programmes

   	
• Complete and pass the MSc education in accordance with the curriculum of the MSc programme  (ONLY when you are attending the integrated MSc and PhD programme) 	
• Carry through an independent research project under supervision 	
• Complete PhD courses corresponding to approx. 30 ECTS / ½ FTE 	
• Participate in active research environments, including a stay at another research institution, preferably abroad 	
• Teaching and knowledge dissemination activities 	
• Write scientific papers aimed at high-impact journals 	
• Write and defend a PhD thesis on the basis of your project   We are looking for the following qualifications and experience:

   	
• Professional qualifications relevant to the PhD project 	
• Relevant work experience 	
• Other relevant professional experience, including publications (if any) 	
• A curious mind-set with a strong interest in Mathematics 	
• Good English skills    

  Application and Assessment Procedure

  Your application including all attachments must be in English and submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW below.

  Please include: 

   	
• Motivated letter of application (max. one page) 	
• Curriculum vitae including information about your education, experience, publications (if any), language skills and other skills relevant for the position 	
• Original diplomas for Bachelor’s or Master’s and transcript of records in the original language, including an authorized English translation if issued in another language than English or Danish. If not completed, a certified/signed copy of a recent transcript of records or a written statement from the institution or supervisor is accepted. 	
• Reference letters (if available; letters can be uploaded as part of the application or sent to hr-math@adm.ku.dk by the reference person).   When you will be affiliated with the University of Copenhagen or otherwise have access to their research, you may be required to undergo a background screening. The purpose is to protect the security and research integrity of the University of Copenhagen.

   

  Application deadline: 

  The deadline for applications is 1 November 2026, 23:59 GMT+1. 

  We reserve the right not to consider material received after the deadline, and not to consider applications that do not live up to the abovementioned requirements.

  The further process 
 After deadline, a number of applicants will be selected for academic assessment (shortlisted) by a committee of unbiased experts. You are notified whether you will be passed for assessment.

  An assessment committee will assess the qualifications and experience of the shortlisted applicants with respect to the research area, skills and other requirements. The assessors will conclude whether each applicant is qualified. The assessed applicants will have the opportunity to comment on their assessment. You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/.

  Questions
 For specific information about the PhD fellowship, please contact the principal supervisor.

  General information about PhD study at the Faculty of SCIENCE is available at the PhD School’s website: https://www.science.ku.dk/phd/.

  The University of Copenhagen wishes to reflect the surrounding community and invites all regardless of personal background to apply for the position.

In this role, you will set the medical strategy, drive evidence generation, and elevate scientific engagement to close evidence gaps and support access for a portfolio that spans pre-launch through life-cycle management.

Our AstraZeneca Nordic Marketing Company employs around 550 people and has offices located in Copenhagen, Stockholm, Oslo, and Espoo. AstraZeneca Nordic is a recognized leader in its core therapy areas and aims to improve the lives of millions of people. This is an area where you are free to be more – you are encouraged to challenge traditional ways and test your curiosity. We drive innovative science, deliver key launches, build close collaboration and partnerships within health care.

You will guide a high-performing office- and field-based team, champion responsible AI adoption, and influence decisions across the enterprise while maintaining Medical independence. How will you translate insights from clinicians, payers and patients into an integrated medical plan that changes practice and accelerates impact?

Accountabilities:

• 
Lead Medical Strategy: Own the country Integrated Medical Plan, connecting therapeutic priorities, patient needs and evidence gaps to measurable impact.

• 
Drive Evidence Generation: Shape the country evidence strategy, including real-world evidence, health data and investigator-sponsored research, in collaboration with Nordic, regional and global teams.

• 
Champion Scientific Leadership: Represent AstraZeneca in scientific and healthcare forums, strengthening our external medical leadership.

• 
Take a proactive and visible leadership internally and externally on how to drive scientific expert mobilisation and advocacy solving market access challenges

• 
Lead by example in external KEE and CoE engagement and establish trusted high level networks of experts

• 
Enable Responsible AI Adoption: Build confidence and capability in AI to enhance scientific impact, efficiency and value, with appropriate human oversight.

• 
Ensure Medical Governance: Provide senior oversight of benefit–risk, compliance and reputational matters, ensuring adherence to internal standards and external regulations.

• 
Influence Cross-Functional Strategy: Bring medical expertise to Market Access, HTA and business planning while safeguarding Medical independence.

• 
Advance Organizational Excellence: Strengthen performance, operating models and ways of working to increase external impact and reduce internal complexity.

• 
Develop Future-Ready Talent: Build a strong leadership pipeline through workforce planning, succession, coaching and inclusive development.

• 
Connect Nordic and Global Priorities: Contribute to Nordic strategy, share best practices across countries and ensure local needs shape broader decision-making.

• 
Manage Resources Strategically: Own medical budgets and deploy resources to priority activities, launches and patient-impact opportunities.

• 
Build Strategic Partnerships: Develop trusted relationships with clinical experts, patient organizations, payers, HTA bodies and healthcare leaders to advance patient outcomes.

Essential Skills/Experience

• 
Scientific Qualification: Advanced degree in Medicine, Pharmacy, Dentistry, Natural Sciences or a related field.

• 
Medical Affairs Leadership: Significant experience leading Medical Affairs strategy, operations and capabilities across therapeutic areas and product lifecycles.

• 
Launch and Portfolio Expertise: Proven success delivering pre-launch, launch and lifecycle activities for complex portfolios.

• 
Senior Leadership: Experience influencing across cross-functional, matrixed, regional and global environments.

• 
People Leadership: Track record of building high-performing teams through coaching, empowerment and accountability.

• 
Strategic and Business Acumen: Ability to connect medical strategy with brand, value and access priorities while maintaining scientific integrity.

•

jobs.occupation: Product Coordinator - Data, structure, and coordination at the heart of our largest product category.
jobs.description:
Are you the kind of person who enjoys bringing order to complexity? Do you take pride in keeping track of details, data, and deadlines? Then you could be the Coordinator we are looking for in our Incontinence and baby diapers team at ABENA!

Incontinence and baby diapers are ABENA's largest product category. At the same time, we are welcoming new digital and innovative product areas into the team, creating exciting opportunities but also increasing the need for structure and coordination. That's why we are looking for a new colleague who can help keep things running smoothly behind the scenes.

This is a role with a very broad range of responsibilities. One day you might be updating master data, checking marketing materials, working with price lists, or creating Excel reports. The next day you could be following up on backorders, supporting a product launch, or helping solve an unexpected operational challenge. New tasks will constantly land on your desk, so it's important that you enjoy variety and take pride in bringing order to complexity.

Simply put, you are the person who puts things on track and helps keep the train moving.

You can expect your main tasks to include:

• Maintain product information and master data across our systems.

• Support new product launches and help coordinate activities across departments.

• Follow up on backorders and product availability, keeping Sales updated.

• Create reports and work with product, pricing, and sales data in Excel.

• Support process improvements, data clean-up, and documentation of workflows.

• Prepare project updates, newsletters, and other communication for internal stakeholders.

We hope you bring:

• A relevant education within business, administration, supply chain, marketing, or a related field.

• An interest in working with product data, reports, and master data, along with a willingness to learn new systems.

• Strong attention to detail and a structured approach to your work.

• The ability to manage multiple tasks at the same time and keep track of many moving parts.

• Confidence working in Excel and a curiosity for turning data into useful insights.

• A proactive and helpful mindset, with a genuine desire to support colleagues and contribute wherever needed.

Your Team, Our Culture and Values

Our team brings together five complementary experts in product management, sourcing, and compliance. We’re driven by a genuine passion for our work and a deep commitment to our category and products. We support one another, celebrate our successes together, and ensure we thrive as a team.

Your leader at ABENA will be Group Concept Manager Birgitte Hausted, who describes her leadership style as follows:

“I adapt my leadership style to the people and teams I work with, and I always meet others with respect for their expertise and strengths. I don’t see failure as losing. I see it as learning and getting better together. Trust and transparency matter a lot to me, and I believe we do our best work when we reflect on and grow as a team.”

Your workplace will be located at the ABENA Headquarter in Aabenraa, Denmark.

At ABENA, you join a global company with a strong purpose: To make a real difference in the everyday lives of people around the world. We combine professionalism with a warm, people-first culture where collaboration, curiosity, and continuous improvement are necessary parts of everyday life. We take pride in delivering high-quality work with integrity, guided by our core values of trust, fairness, and cooperation. These values shape how we lead, support one another, and create meaningful impact for our customers and communities.

We look forward to receiving your application

If you are interested in the position, please send your application and CV as soon as possible. We process applications as we receive them, and we close the search when we have found our new colleague.

Read more about our recruitment process here.

If you would like further information about the job, please feel free to contact Birgitte Hausted, Group Concept Manager, on +45 5158 0484.

**The Impact You'll Make

**Danfoss Business System (DBS) was founded in 2003 and is a world class improvement organization with one overall purpose: To ensure that Danfoss has a best-in-class performance. The organization consists of highly qualified specialists split into more than 20 nationalities, who can all challenge and support the businesses as well as develop the practices and solutions needed to take Danfoss to the next level.

DBS specializes in supporting Danfoss factories with a standardized approach to continuously strengthen Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, and Inventory.

As a Delivery Performance Excellence Expert, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams to design, develop, and implement effective supply chain processes that improve delivery performance to customers and enhance customer satisfaction, with a strong end-to-end focus. The position offers a unique opportunity to contribute to transformation initiatives and make a tangible impact on business results.

In this role, you will be operating in a multicultural environment with highly competent colleagues from all over the world.

We are a global organization with more than 100 factories across the world and therefore it is important that you have the flexibility and willingness to travel, approx. 70% of the time supporting our various locations. When not travelling, you will have the flexibility of working from home or from one of our offices.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Lead supply chain transformation projects across manufacturing sites, identifying and implementing end-to-end improvements in planning, procurement, production, logistics, and customer service.

• Drive delivery performance excellence using DBS methodologies, helping factories improve customer delivery results and achieve ambitious performance targets.

• Implement and strengthen performance management systems, using data and insights to monitor results, identify gaps, and accelerate improvements.

• Drive continuous improvement across Delivery and Inventory through facilitation of Kaizen workshops, process mapping activities, and capability-building initiatives, enabling teams to adopt sustainable ways of working.

• Partner with stakeholders across operations, supply chain, and support functions to build a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, and high performance.

**What We're Looking For

**

• Proven experience in supply chain management within a manufacturing environment, with expertise in areas such as SIOP, Planning, Procurement, CRM, WMS, or TMS

• Strong understanding of end-to-end supply chain processes and hands-on experience leading supply chain transformation and performance improvement initiatives in manufacturing Industry or consultancy supporting manufacturing industry.

• Experience working with SAP, Planning & Forecasting systems, SAP BI, Power BI, and advanced Excel for analysis and decision-making.

• Strong project leadership, stakeholder management, and facilitation skills, with the ability to influence teams across a matrix organization. A structured, analytical, and data-driven approach to problem-solving, combined with excellent communication and presentation skills.

• Interest and experience in digital technologies, data analytics, process transformation, and operational excellence.

• Willingness and flexibility to travel globally up to 70% of the time.

**What You'll Get From Us

**

• We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.

• You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us.

• We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are.

• You’ll receive benefits on top of your salary. More information shall be provided during the recruitment process.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

**Our Commitment to Transparency

**Salary ranges listed reflect only primary location and currency. For local salary ranges and specific benefits in your preferred hiring location, please ask your Talent Acquisition representative for more information.

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

jobs.occupation: Senior Manager, Campaign Design - Store Creative
jobs.description:
We are looking for a highly creative and experienced Campaign Design Manager to join our Campaign Creative team in Copenhagen.

In this role, you will transform global campaign ideas into immersive and engaging retail experiences. From windows and in-store creative to activations, installations and pop-ups, you will shape how campaigns come to life across the physical customer journey, ensuring every touchpoint feels connected, inspiring and unmistakably on brand.

You will combine strategic creative thinking with hands-on leadership, guiding projects from concept to implementation-ready toolkits while collaborating with cross-functional teams, external partners and creative specialists.

What you will do

Drive retail campaign experiences

• 
Translate global campaigns and brand direction into compelling retail concepts.

• 
Create cohesive experiences across windows, stores, activations, installations and pop-ups.

• 
Develop concepts that balance creativity, customer engagement and commercial impact.

• 
Explore new formats, materials and creative collaborations that elevate brand storytelling.

• 
Ensure solutions are scalable globally while remaining flexible for local markets.

Lead global campaign toolkits

• 
Develop and define creative direction for global retail campaign toolkits.

• 
Create clear, inspiring guidance that supports local adaptation and execution.

• 
Partner closely with key stakeholders to ensure creative intent is maintained from concept through implementation.

Lead and develop creative talent

• 
Inspire, coach and develop a multidisciplinary creative team.

• 
Guide concept development and provide constructive creative feedback.

• 
Foster a culture of curiosity, experimentation and high creative standards.

Partner across the business

• 
Collaborate with Communications, Operations, Product Design and other key functions to deliver cohesive campaign experiences.

• 
Present concepts and recommendations to senior stakeholders.

• 
Work with external agencies, artists and production partners to bring ideas to life.

Deliver from concept to execution

• 
Lead projects through concept development, prototyping and production handover.

• 
Balance creative ambition with timelines, budgets and operational realities.

• 
Manage multiple campaign workstreams while maintaining exceptional attention to detail.

Who you are

You are a creative leader with a passion for physical retail and experiential design. You understand how to turn campaign ideas into engaging customer experiences and are equally comfortable defining the big-picture vision and refining the details that make execution exceptional.

You thrive in a global environment, build strong relationships across diverse stakeholder groups and know how to bring people together around a shared creative direction.

We imagine you bring

• 
Significant experience, typically gained over 8+ years, in retail design, visual merchandising, spatial design, experiential design, or a related creative discipline.

• 
Experience creating retail experiences for premium, fashion, jewellery, lifestyle or other design-led brands.

• 
A strong portfolio demonstrating both conceptual thinking and executed work.

• 
Experience translating campaign or brand ideas into physical retail environments.

• 
Strong stakeholder management and presentation skills.

• 
Experience leading or mentoring creative teams.

• 
Knowledge of the end-to-end process from concept through production and implementation.

• 
Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite and related creative tools.

• 
Professional fluency in English.

What will make you stand out

A portfolio that demonstrates how you have transformed ideas into compelling physical experiences, connecting storytelling, product, space and customer interaction.

We're looking for someone who can combine creative vision, leadership and execution, bringing bold ideas to life at a global scale.

About Pandora

Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

You will join a global brand known for combining creativity, craftsmanship and innovation, helping shape inspiring customer experiences that connect people with the stories behind our jewellery. As part of Pandora's Campaign Creative team, you will have the opportunity to influence how our campaigns come to life in stores around the world, creating meaningful moments for millions of customers every day.
